name: NERVE CIRCUIT: Underground Reflex Wars
subcategory: underground game circuit / illegal neural reflex competition
description: NERVE CIRCUIT is the dominant underground reflex competition format in GLMZ's Tier 1-2 districts, run through pirated BCI tournament nodes hidden in basement server stacks and decommissioned industrial spaces. Players compete in pure neural-speed challenges — reaction windows measured in microseconds, sensory overload endurance tests, and reflex prediction duels — with no safety governors on the BCI feedback intensity. The circuit has produced several players whose neural response times genuinely exceed what unmodified human hardware should permit, sparking rumors about illegal BCI modifications being administered by circuit organizers.
story_hooks: A NEUROSTRIKE LEAGUE scout attends a NERVE CIRCUIT event and witnesses a player perform something that should be neurologically impossible — and has to decide whether to report it or recruit them.

The underground surgeon removing pain governors from NERVE CIRCUIT competitors is offering a much darker modification to a select few — one that the players don't fully understand until it's too late.
A Tier 2 investigative journalist embeds in NERVE CIRCUIT to expose the injury cover-ups and finds themselves being subtly pressured by someone with serious corporate resources to drop the story.
